exposure: timing of hyperthyroidism diagnosis (before vs. during pregnancy)
finding: Hyperthyroid women had higher odds of obstetrical complications, including preeclampsia, IUGR, preterm labor and birth, GDM, cesarean delivery, and induction of labor, while their newborns had lower birth weight.
mod_finding: Women with hyperthyroidism had higher odds of cesarean delivery compared to normal women.
birth_weight: Newborns of hyperthyroid mothers had lower birth weight than normal ones
